tagline: Blue Origin's first-generation lunar cargo lander — single-stage hydrogen / oxygen vehicle, ~3 t to the surface
description: Single-stage cryogenic lander built around the LH₂ / LOX BE-7 engine. Mk1 is the cargo-only precursor to the much larger Mk2 crewed Artemis HLS variant; both share the BE-7 propulsion and hydrogen-based reusability architecture. The first crewed lunar flight to carry Blue Moon Mk1 has not yet launched, with first landing currently planned no earlier than 2026. Cargo Mk1 will deliver up to ~3000 kg to the lunar surface; the crewed Mk2 derivative anchored Blue Origin's HLS contract awarded by NASA in 2023 as the second Artemis-era human lander alongside SpaceX Starship HLS.
best_known_for: Blue Origin cargo lunar lander — BE-7 hydrogen propulsion, ~3 t to the surface, NASA CLPS
